name: The Royal Mead Feast
description: The King demands 20 meads for the royal banquet!

name: Army Ale Supply
description: The General needs 30 ales for the troops. Any ale will do.

name: The Queen's Bouquet
description: The Queen desires drinks with floral notes. 10 floral brews.

name: The Spice Merchant's Dare
description: Omar challenges all brewers: who can brew 15 spiced drinks?

name: The Collector's Request
description: A mysterious collector seeks 5 rare (★★★★) or better drinks.

name: Regional Showcase
description: The Bazaar is hosting a regional festival! Brew 10 drinks using ingredients from your home region.

name: The Trade Route Challenge
description: Export 5 drinks to 3 different regions. Show the world your brews!

name: The Grand Master's Test
description: Brew 1 legendary (★★★★★) drink. Only the greatest brewmasters attempt this.

name: The Brewmaster's Sprint
description: Brew and sell 10 drinks in 30 minutes. Any quality. Speed is king!

name: The Variety Show
description: Brew 8 DIFFERENT recipes. No repeats! Show your range.
